constitution.history: several previous; latest adopted 28 June 1992, entered into force 3 July 1992
constitution.amend: proposed by at least one-fifth of Parliament members or by the president of the republic; passage requires three readings of the proposed amendment and a simple majority vote in two successive memberships of Parliament; passage of amendments to the "General Provisions" and "Amendment of the Constitution" chapters requires at least three-fifths majority vote by Parliament to conduct a referendum and majority vote in a referendum

courts.highest: Supreme Court (consists of 19 justices, including the chief justice, and organized into civil, criminal, administrative, and constitutional review chambers)
courts.judges: the chief justice is proposed by the president of the republic and appointed by the Riigikogu; other justices proposed by the chief justice and appointed by the Riigikogu; justices appointed for life
courts.lower: circuit (appellate) courts; administrative, county, city, and specialized courts

citizenship.descent: at least one parent must be a citizen of Estonia

suffrage: 18 years of age; universal; age 16 for local elections
world: accepts compulsory ICJ jurisdiction with reservations; accepts ICCt jurisdiction

b: Illegal drugs, including cannabis, are strictly prohibited, even in very small quantities. Severe penalties apply for possessing, using, buying, or smuggling illegal drugs, including when transiting through airports. You should expect long jail sentences of up to 10 years and heavy fines.
Airports in Estonia have excellent technology and security for detecting illegal items. This is also used to scan the baggage of transiting passengers.
Same-sex sexual activity is legal in Estonia, and same-sex marriages have been recognised since 1 January 2024.
